subject: Need to move today's call
text:
Hi,

I need to move our call today because one part of the materials is still unfinished. I don’t want to rush you or leave the details unclear.

If you are free tomorrow afternoon, I could connect then. I’ll have the missing piece ready and can send it ahead of time so we use the call better.

Please let me know what works. Sorry for the short notice. I appreciate your understanding while I finish this.
